moves.name: Fly
notes: Bowarrow is on the field for up to 60 frames (param_bowarrow.life), which is what ends the hit -- its script never does. Hitting something usually ends it sooner.
The arrow deals 4–12%. The figure in its script is not used: the engine sets the power from its params (param_bowarrow.power_min, param_bowarrow.power_max). Charging the bow is what raises it.
